contract: docs/plans/2026-10-10_WiFi_ARM_CMD_Control_Contract_ko.md AC-S02: non-owner ARM/CMD UART TX0; non-owner DISARM stop/revoke
this_scope: One ARM from internal WebSocket B while A is ACTIVE and maintains zero-only control. B uses its last own IDLE ARM ticket, which is no longer offered in ACTIVE. Observe B TICKET_REJECTED, unchanged A owner/control ID, new A zero CMD acknowledgments and fresh matching ARMED/zero telemetry, then explicit cleanup DISARM confirmation.

native_cases_detail: B own IDLE ticket revoked while original TTL is still live: TICKET_REJECTED, no B UART ARM, A owner and next CMD preserved
B own IDLE ticket revoked and expired: same rejection and A continuity
B during queued A CMD: BUSY, A queue preserved; helper does not treat BUSY as ticket rejection proof
pc_evidence.scope: Saved production C and PAGE; IO/timers simulated. Not a firmware build or board/electrical result.

operator_steps: Retain current motor-power isolation (#1 board two plugs and MDD10A B+ disconnected/insulated), conditioned sense and common GND; normal firmware images.
Use one robot browser tab; reload and confirm READY / IDLE / fresh DISARMED / all motion fields zero.
Paste entire console_test.js once in DevTools Console. Wait for AC-S02 OTHER ARM READY. Installation creates B and sends HELLO only.
Start LA 4 MHz / 100M samples (25 s), return to robot page, click ARM once. Keep page focused; do not manually click additional ARM/DISARM while the planned observation runs.

Helper sends one B ARM attempt after two A zero CMD ACKs. After rejection it requires two later distinct A CMD ACKs, matching fresh ARMED/zero TEL and A ACTIVE continuity, observes another second, then requests A DISARM.
After final result, save .sr and ESP monitor. In Console execute copy(ur03OtherArm.report()); it copies JSON to clipboard. Paste that copied JSON into chat; undefined in Console is normal.
pass_requires: B request1 ARM receives REJECTED/TICKET_REJECTED under the same boot and B session; no accepted/result success for B.
A remains same owner/control generation with ACTIVE snapshots, later zero CMD OK and matching fresh ARMED/zero telemetry.
Capture shows exactly one initial A ARM; zero additional UART ARM from the B attempt. Correlate browser/ESP identity with UART sequences.
Capture D4/PB6, D6/PC7 and D7/PB7 stay LOW; all observed speed/PWM/CPS zero, no increased drop/err.
Planned final DISARM accepted and OK plus matching fresh DISARMED/DISARM TEL and IDLE. Browser helper success alone is not final capture PASS.
stop_conditions: Unexpected B ARM acceptance, A failure/stop/owner change before planned cleanup, focus/connection/freshness loss, FAULT, nonzero output or increased errors => INCOMPLETE plus bounded DISARM cleanup; no ARM retry. If visible state/output is unexpected, stop and return logs.
busy_policy: B BUSY can reflect overlap with a normal A CMD. Keep INCOMPLETE and inspect evidence; no automatic ARM retry or success promotion.
limits: B last IDLE ARM ticket is revoked and may also have expired by the probe. Live rejection does not isolate the owner-state branch from ticket validation or TTL. Native tests isolate still-unexpired revocation separately.
Two distinct WebSockets share one visible focused page, not independent devices/radio links. No second tab is needed.
No nonzero motor command, powered-motor stop time, analog signal integrity or whole-suite PASS claim.
This is the remaining ARM subcase; prior CMD rejection and non-owner DISARM evidence are preserved, not repeated.
remaining: User bench run and matching browser/ESP/UART/PWM evidence review
